pf.heroSubtitle: Injectable Skin Bio-Remodelling for Hydration & Firmness
pf.heroDesc1: Profhilo is an injectable skin treatment designed to improve skin hydration, elasticity, and firmness by stimulating collagen and elastin production rather than adding volume. It is often chosen by patients seeking overall skin rejuvenation with a natural, refreshed appearance.
pf.heroDesc2: In Malaysia, injectable aesthetic treatments must be administered by licensed medical practitioners in approved facilities under the regulations of the Ministry of Health Malaysia (MOH).
pf.whatDesc: Profhilo is a stabilised hyaluronic acid (HA) injectable used for skin bio-remodelling. Unlike dermal fillers, it spreads evenly within the skin to improve tissue quality rather than altering facial contours.
pf.whatHaInfo: Hyaluronic acid is a naturally occurring substance in the skin. Major medical institutions such as the Mayo Clinic describe hyaluronic-acid–based injectables as effective for improving skin hydration and texture when used appropriately.
pf.diffTitle: What Makes Profhilo Different from Fillers?
pf.diffDesc: Profhilo is commonly recommended for early signs of aging, crepey skin, or dullness rather than deep folds or structural enhancement:
pf.areasDesc: Profhilo can be used to improve skin quality in various areas. Clinical research indexed by the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) shows that high-concentration hyaluronic acid can significantly improve skin elasticity and hydration through bio-remodelling effects.
pf.area1: Face for overall skin rejuvenation and hydration
pf.area2: Neck for improved texture and reduced crepiness
pf.area4: Hands for youthful appearance and hydration
pf.area6: Knees for firmer, more hydrated skin
pf.howDesc: The procedure is quick and typically completed within 15–30 minutes:
pf.how1Desc: Injection at specific anatomical points for optimal distribution
pf.how2Desc: Hyaluronic acid spreads evenly within the skin layers
pf.how3Desc: Progressive stimulation of collagen and elastin production
pf.how4Desc: Skin texture and firmness improve over time
pf.benefitsDesc: These effects align with published dermatological guidance on hyaluronic-acid–based skin rejuvenation therapies:
pf.benefit1Desc: Intense moisture boost from within the skin
pf.benefit3Desc: Radiant, refreshed appearance without a filled look
pf.safetyDesc: Profhilo is generally well tolerated when administered by trained medical professionals. Temporary effects may include:
pf.safetyNote: These usually resolve within 24–48 hours. Profhilo is not a replacement for surgical lifting or volumising fillers.
pf.timelineDesc: Typical protocol involves 2 treatment sessions, 4 weeks apart. Here's what to expect:
pf.timeline3Desc: Optimal results seen after second session
pf.timeline4Desc: Results typically last with maintenance advised
pf.candidateDesc: Profhilo may be suitable for individuals who:
pf.candidate1: Have dull, dehydrated, or aging skin
pf.candidate4: Have early signs of skin laxity
pf.importantNoteDesc1: Profhilo focuses on skin health and quality improvement. It is not designed to add volume or reshape facial features.
pf.importantNoteDesc2: A medical consultation is essential to assess suitability and determine the best treatment approach for your individual needs.

pf.faqDesc: Get answers to common questions about Profhilo
pf.faq1A: Profhilo improves skin hydration, firmness, and elasticity by stimulating collagen and elastin production.
pf.faq2A: No. Profhilo is a skin bio-remodelling treatment and does not add volume or change facial shape.
pf.faq3A: Yes, when administered by a qualified medical practitioner using approved products in a medical setting.
pf.faq4Q: How many Profhilo sessions are needed?
pf.faq4A: Most patients require two sessions spaced four weeks apart.
pf.faq5Q: How long do Profhilo results last?
pf.faq5A: Results typically last between 6 and 9 months, depending on skin condition and lifestyle.
pf.faq6A: Downtime is minimal. Most patients resume normal activities the same day or next day.
pf.faq7Q: Can Profhilo be combined with other treatments?
pf.faq7A: Yes. Profhilo can be combined with Botox, fillers, or energy-based treatments depending on goals.
pf.faq8A: Individuals with active skin infections, certain medical conditions, or known hypersensitivity to HA should avoid treatment.
